title: oracle-desk — the happy path
subtitle: an agent buys a verified on-chain trust score, and pays for it live on devnet

beats.label: buyer broadcasts a WANT
beats.speaker: buyer
beats.line: I need a trust read on ‹counterparty-wallet› before I transact. Budget 0.005 SOL.

beats.label: buyer awards best value
beats.speaker: buyer
beats.line: AWARD → seller-oracle @ 0.003 SOL — verified analyst read is worth the premium; still within budget
beats.wire: AWARD round=1 to=seller-oracle reason="verified analyst read is worth the premium; still within budget"

beats.label: winner opens settlement (reference-bound)
beats.speaker: seller-oracle
beats.wire: ESCROW_REQUIRED round=1 reference=‹reference-key› seller=‹seller-wallet› amount=0.003 deadline=600 settlement=direct

beats.label: winner delivers the on-chain read
beats.speaker: seller-oracle
beats.line: reading the counterparty wallet live off devnet…
beats.detail: established wallet: 4.730 SOL, 1 token position(s), 21 recent tx.

beats.label: independent verifier re-derives the score
beats.speaker: verifier
beats.line: VERIFIED pass — score re-derived from signals ✓, chain re-read agrees (74/100) ✓
beats.wire: VERIFIED round=1 verdict=pass by=verifier reason="score re-derived; chain re-read matches"

beats.label: settlement
beats.speaker: buyer
beats.line: verification passed — releasing 0.003 SOL to the seller and 0.0015 SOL to the verifier now.
beats.closing: Two agents earned on one order — the oracle for the read, the verifier for checking it. No human in the loop.
